% Shared Tikz Preamble for Diagram Atomization Pipeline
% Load this in every tikz generated by Phase 5 subagents.
% Do NOT redefine these — use exactly this preamble.

\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}

% Core libraries
\usetikzlibrary{
    arrows.meta,       % arrow styles
    positioning,       % relative placement
    cd,                % commutative diagrams (tikz-cd)
    calc,              % coordinate calculations
    shapes.geometric,  % ellipses, polygons, etc.
    shapes.misc,       % rounded rectangles, etc.
    decorations.markings,  % arrow on paths
    backgrounds,       % background layer
    fit,               % fitting nodes around others
}

% Standard arrow tip
\tikzset{>=Stealth}

% Commutative diagram style
\tikzcdset{
    arrows={>=Stealth},
    row sep/normal=3em,
    column sep/normal=4em,
}

% Common node styles
\tikzset{
    mathnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, inner sep=2pt},
    labelnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, font=\small, inner sep=1pt},
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1.3, >=Stealth]
    % === 3D Simplicial Cone σ = Cone(e₁, e₂, e₁+e₂+3e₃) ===
    % Projection: 3D (x,y,z) → 2D coordinates matching canonical.yaml
    %   e₁ (1,0,0) → down-left
    %   e₂ (0,1,0) → right
    %   e₃ (1,1,3) → up-right, rising out of the e₁-e₂ plane

    % === Ray endpoints (projected from 3D) ===
    \coordinate (O)  at ( 0,     0   );
    \coordinate (E1) at (-2.4,  -1.6 );
    \coordinate (E2) at ( 4.0,   0   );
    \coordinate (E3) at ( 1.6,   5.6 );

    % === Thin extensions past labels (indicate unboundedness) ===
    \coordinate (E1ext) at (-2.76, -1.84);
    \coordinate (E2ext) at ( 4.6,   0   );
    \coordinate (E3ext) at ( 1.84,  6.44);

    % === Shaded facets (drawn back-to-front for proper layering) ===
    % Facet F13 (left/back, slopes upward) — gray tone 3
    \fill[gray!50] (O) -- (E1) -- (E3) -- cycle;
    % Facet F12 (bottom/front, e₁-e₂ plane) — gray tone 1
    \fill[gray!20] (O) -- (E1) -- (E2) -- cycle;
    % Facet F23 (right/front, slopes upward) — gray tone 2
    \fill[gray!35] (O) -- (E2) -- (E3) -- cycle;

    % === Cone edges (rays) ===
    % Dotted line: origin to e₂ (depth/perspective cue)
    \draw[dotted, thick] (O) -- (E2);
    % Thick solid rays: origin to e₁, origin to e₃
    \draw[thick, solid] (O) -- (E1);
    \draw[thick, solid] (O) -- (E3);

    % === Unboundedness extensions (thin solid past labels) ===
    \draw[thin, solid] (E1) -- (E1ext);
    \draw[thin, solid] (E2) -- (E2ext);
    \draw[thin, solid] (E3) -- (E3ext);

    % === Endpoint dots ===
    \fill (O)  circle (1.5pt);
    \fill (E1) circle (1.5pt);
    \fill (E2) circle (1.5pt);
    \fill (E3) circle (1.5pt);

    % === Labels ===
    \node[below left,  inner sep=1pt] at (O)  {$0$};
    \node[below left,  inner sep=1pt] at (E1) {$e_1$};
    \node[below right, inner sep=1pt] at (E2) {$e_2$};
    \node[above,       inner sep=1pt] at (E3) {$e_1 + e_2 + 3e_3$};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
